title: Migraine Episode
description: I have had a throbbing headache on one side of my head, extreme sensitivity to light, and mild nausea for the past 4 hours.

title: Seasonal Allergies / Rhinitis
description: Constant sneezing, runny nose with clear mucus, watery itchy eyes, and slight throat irritation starting this morning.

title: Gastroenteritis / Stomach Bug
description: Nausea, mild fever, sharp stomach cramps, and frequent watery diarrhea after eating food from outside last night.

title: Viral Respiratory Infection / Cold
description: Low-grade fever (100°F), dry cough, severe body aches, mild fatigue, and a congested nose for 2 days.

title: Acid Reflux / GERD Flare-up
description: Burning sensation in the upper chest, sour taste in the back of the throat, and bloating shortly after eating a heavy meal.
